title: Cities & Architecture
description: The built world in photography — grand skylines, streets, and monuments, from Belle Époque photochroms to Atget's Paris.

items.title: Sunnyside, Home of Washington Irving
items.description_narrative: Ivy nearly swallows this stuccoed cottage, its stepped gables and clustered chimney pots peeking through the leaves. A curving gravel drive sweeps past an arched doorway, the lawn's long shadows suggesting late afternoon.
items.tags: ivy-covered cottage, gothic revival, chimneys, gravel drive, romantic architecture
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: The Albert Memorial, London
items.description_narrative: A gilded spire rises through a canopy of ornate pointed tracery, a small cross topping its pinnacle. Beneath the arch a seated statue looks out over marble steps, carved figures clustered at each corner while the surrounding park's trees close in behind.
items.tags: gothic revival, memorial, spire, statue, park, monument, gilded architecture
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: The Waag, Nieuwmarkt, Amsterdam
items.description_narrative: A cluster of pointed turrets crowns this brick fortress-like building, its conical roofs doubled in the still canal before it. Market stalls and small boats gather along the water's edge, trees lining both banks of the quiet waterway.
items.tags: turreted building, canal, market stalls, reflection, brick architecture
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: The Betsy Ross House, Philadelphia
items.description_narrative: A narrow brick rowhouse with green shutters and a steep gabled roof flies flags from an upper window, a hand-lettered sign above the door inviting visitors in. A ladder leans against the wall beside a shop window crowded with framed pictures.

items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: The Belfry and Canal, Bruges

items.tags: canal, reflection, belfry, brick gables, flemish architecture, waterway
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: The National Bank, Bucharest

items.title: Cheapside, London

items.tags: victorian street, horse omnibus, crowd, shopfronts, church spire, urban bustle
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: View of Vienna from the Riesenrad
items.description_narrative: Rooftops spread in a dense patchwork toward distant hills, a church spire and a scattering of domes breaking the skyline. An elevated train crosses a brick viaduct through the trees below, smoke trailing from its locomotive.
items.tags: aerial cityscape, elevated train, viaduct, rooftops, distant hills
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: General View of Miskolc, Hungary
items.description_narrative: Rooftops and church spires spread across a valley town below, rolling green hills rising beyond it into the haze. Three boys in straw hats perch together on a wooden fence rail at the overlook, taking in the view.
items.tags: hilltop view, town panorama, church spires, rolling hills, children
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: Venice Harbour
items.description_narrative: A domed rooftop ornamented with carved urns and statues frames the view across open water toward a distant bell tower and church. A steamship and a sailing vessel sit at anchor, a lone gondolier poling past in the foreground.
items.tags: harbor view, domed rooftop, bell tower, steamship, gondolier, waterfront
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: The Hofburg Palace, Vienna
items.description_narrative: A sweeping curved facade of columns and statue-topped domes encloses the plaza, its central archway leading toward unseen courtyards beyond. Figures cross the open square in ones and twos, a horse cart pausing near the entrance.
items.tags: baroque palace, curved facade, domes, statuary, plaza, imperial architecture
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: Holborn Viaduct, London
items.description_narrative: An ornate curved corner building anchors a busy intersection, its balustraded roofline and arched windows rising above a row of horse-drawn omnibuses. Pedestrians and carriages crowd the street below in the midday bustle.
items.tags: victorian street, corner building, horse omnibus, urban bustle, ornate facade
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: Kahlenberg, Vienna
items.description_narrative: A cluster of towered buildings crowns a wooded hilltop, their pale walls emerging above rows of trees. Open grassy slopes and scattered shrubs fall away in the foreground, the hillside catching soft afternoon light.
items.tags: hilltop building, wooded hill, towers, rural landscape, pastoral view
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: Kossuth Monument, Miskolc
items.description_narrative: A bronze figure raises an arm atop a tall pedestal at the center of a tree-lined park, a domed building rising beyond the leafy canopy. Pedestrians in straw hats and long skirts stroll the gravel paths, flowerbeds bordering the walk.
items.tags: bronze statue, park, monument, domed building, pedestrians, garden path
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: Lambeth Palace, London
items.description_narrative: A paddle steamer crowded with passengers churns white foam across the river, its wake spreading toward the embankment. Behind it, crenellated brick towers and chimneys rise above a line of trees along the water's edge.
items.tags: river steamer, paddle boat, brick towers, riverside, embankment, passengers
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: Leopoldsberg, Vienna
items.description_narrative: A small building crowns a rounded, tree-covered hill rising above a village of red-roofed houses and a slender church spire. A man in a dark coat pauses along the fenced path in the foreground, a wayside shrine just visible behind him.
items.tags: hilltop chapel, wooded hill, village, church spire, wayside shrine, rural path
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: London Bridge
items.description_narrative: A row of stone arches carries a bridge thick with horse-drawn buses and carts, the traffic packed edge to edge. Boats drift on the water below, a tall column and a church spire rising above the crowded rooftops beyond.
items.tags: stone bridge, river traffic, horse omnibus, city skyline, arches
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: A Vienna Marketplace
items.description_narrative: A bronze rider on horseback surveys a marketplace crowded with striped umbrellas and vendor stalls, a relief panel carved into the pedestal below. Shoppers move between the awnings, tall apartment buildings enclosing the square on every side.
items.tags: equestrian statue, market square, vendor umbrellas, bronze monument, plaza
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: The Market, Bremerhaven
items.description_narrative: A bronze statue rises from the center of a bustling market square, ringed by trees and busy stalls piled with goods. Ornate gabled buildings and a distant spire frame the crowd of shoppers moving between the carts and awnings.
items.tags: market square, statue, street vendors, gabled buildings, church spire, crowd
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: Church of St. Étienne-du-Mont, Paris
items.description_narrative: A tiered stone facade rises to a clock tower topped with a small dome, its rose window and scrolled gables catching the afternoon light. A crowd gathers on the church steps and square below, small figures scattered across the open plaza.
items.tags: gothic renaissance facade, clock tower, rose window, church steps, crowd, paris
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: The Parliament Building, Vienna
items.description_narrative: A columned facade rises behind statue-topped structures, a triangular pediment crowning the entrance at the end of a long, tree-lined avenue. Rows of young trees march along the boulevard in the foreground, their canopies still low.
items.tags: neoclassical facade, columns, pediment, tree-lined avenue, statues
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: Ca' Pesaro, Venice
items.description_narrative: A baroque palace faces the canal in tiers of arched windows and deep-cut stonework, its facade doubled faintly in the water. A gondolier in a broad hat poles a covered boat past the mooring posts, a passenger seated beneath its canopy.
items.tags: venetian palazzo, baroque architecture, canal, gondola, grand canal, stone facade
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: Piccadilly Circus, London
items.description_narrative: A winged bronze figure balances atop a fountain at the center of a wheel-shaped intersection, crowded on every side by horse-drawn cabs and omnibuses. Pedestrians throng the pavements beneath an ornate corner building's columned facade.
items.tags: fountain statue, busy intersection, horse omnibus, crowd, ornate facade
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: Ca' Rezzonico, Venice
items.description_narrative: Rounded arches and paired columns rise across three storeys of a canal-front palace, balconies overlooking the water below. In the foreground a woman stands in a moored gondola while her gondolier rests his oar, other boats gliding past the building's reflection.
items.tags: venetian palazzo, canal, gondola, baroque facade, columns, grand canal
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: The Royal Exchange, London
items.description_narrative: Fluted columns support a triangular pediment carved with figures, a slender clock tower rising just behind the roofline. An equestrian statue stands in the square before it, horse-drawn omnibuses and a milling crowd filling the open space.
items.tags: neoclassical facade, pediment sculpture, clock tower, equestrian statue, crowd, horse omnibus
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: Fort Crown Point Ruins, New York
items.description_narrative: Weathered stone chimneys stand in a row along a crumbling fortress wall, the roofless ruin overtaken by grass and shrubs. A broad lake stretches beyond, distant hills fading into haze under a pale sky.
items.tags: fort ruins, stone wall, chimneys, lake view, overgrown ruins, historic ruins
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: Church of Saint-Augustin, Paris
items.description_narrative: A domed church rises behind a broad rose window and columned porch, framed by tall street trees on either side. Horse-drawn omnibuses and carriages cross the square below, passengers boarding as pedestrians move among them.
items.tags: dome, rose window, church facade, horse omnibus, city square, belle epoque
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: St. Augustine's Bridge, Bristol
items.description_narrative: A curving stone parapet follows the water's edge, a slender clock tower rising above the rooftops in the distance. Horse-drawn trams and carts cross the roadway, boats moored quietly along the quay below.
items.tags: stone bridge, clock tower, horse tram, quay, riverside street
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: The Thames Embankment, London
items.description_narrative: A row of grand buildings and a tree-lined promenade curve along a wide river, with a slender obelisk rising above the embankment wall. A paddle steamer trails smoke and wake on the water below a stone bridge, while a lone figure walks along the riverside path.
items.tags: london, thames, embankment, river, cityscape, photochrom, victorian
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: The Paris Opéra (Palais Garnier)
items.description_narrative: Horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians cross a broad paved square before a grand domed building with a colonnaded facade and gilded statues along its roofline. Carved reliefs and arched windows ornament the stone facade, and a woman in a long white dress stands near a lamppost in the foreground.
items.tags: paris, opera house, palais garnier, belle epoque, cityscape, photochrom, architecture
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: The Piazzetta, Venice
items.description_narrative: A tall brick bell tower rises beside two ancient columns, one topped with a winged lion, overlooking a row of moored gondolas. An arcaded palace with diamond-patterned walls lines the waterfront, its lace-like windows catching the light.
items.tags: bell tower, columns, gondolas, arcaded palace, waterfront, venetian architecture
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: The Tower of London
items.description_narrative: Turreted stone towers rise in tiers behind a crenellated outer wall, a line of trees softening the fortress's massive silhouette. Horse-drawn carriages wait along the road in front, clouds piling dramatically above the ancient stonework.
items.tags: castle towers, fortress, crenellated wall, carriages, historic stronghold
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: The University of Vienna
items.description_narrative: Domed corner pavilions anchor either end of a long, arcaded building, twin church spires rising just behind its rooftop. A tree-lined avenue with streetcar tracks runs along the front, hazy hills visible far in the distance.
items.tags: renaissance revival, domed pavilions, tree-lined avenue, streetcar tracks, urban skyline
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: The Three Bridges, Venice
items.description_narrative: Weathered buildings crowd close along a narrow canal, their balconies and shuttered windows leaning almost to the water. Moored gondolas cluster at the mooring poles below, two men pausing along the low brick wall above.
items.tags: narrow canal, gondolas, venetian buildings, mooring poles, waterway
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: Venice Harbour and the Doge's Palace
items.description_narrative: A broad stone promenade crowded with strolling figures steps down to a row of moored gondolas along the water. Tall-masted ships and a smoking steamer anchor further out, their silhouettes rising above the harbor's calm surface.
items.tags: harbor promenade, gondolas, tall ships, waterfront crowd, steamer
items.license_basis: Public Domain — LoC Prints & Photographs, no known restrictions

items.title: The Votivkirche, Vienna
items.description_narrative: Twin openwork spires taper to fine points above a rose window and three carved portals, the church's pale stone catching the light. Formal garden paths and clipped lawns spread before it, a few pedestrians crossing in the shade of young trees.
items.tags: gothic revival, twin spires, rose window, formal garden, church facade

items.title: Westminster Abbey, London
items.description_narrative: Twin pinnacled towers rise above a rose window and a run of flying buttresses, the abbey's pale stone weathered by age. Mature trees crowd the foreground, an iron fence marking the edge of the churchyard below.
items.tags: gothic towers, rose window, flying buttresses, churchyard, abbey

items.title: The Wurstelprater, Vienna
items.description_narrative: A giant wheel rises above the treetops at the end of a broad, tree-lined avenue, its spokes catching the afternoon light. Horse carts and strolling figures move along the wide street, telegraph poles marching off into the distance.
items.tags: ferris wheel, tree-lined avenue, amusement park, horse carts, pedestrians
